verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a full REST API with OpenAPI spec (verified live), a CLI and Python SDK built on it, scoped API keys for automation/CI, and even a dedicated 'agent skill' letting AI coding assistants drive the platform programmatically. This is corroborated by a probe confirming the OpenAPI endpoint returns 200 with valid schema. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically about API usage (community evidence mostly discusses pricing/reliability, not API experience).
